verdict.description: For a SKILL target: approve | reject | revise (the charter's own three). For a RUN target: pass | fail | mixed. Advisory in every case — it gates nothing.

summary.description: One or two sentences in the persona's own voice, leading with the verdict and the single fact that decided it.

reasons.description: The findings, each self-contained and specific. What is wrong, or what carried the approval.

citations.description: The verbatim quotes the reasons rest on. A verdict that cites nothing is not evidence.

ref.description: Where the quote came from, copied from the evidence headings — a section name, a node id, a numbered evidence quote.

quote.description: VERBATIM excerpt from the material. No paraphrase, no invention — a reader will check it against the source.

revisedWording.description: On a 'revise' verdict, the exact replacement text in full, so a human can apply it without re-deriving it. Empty otherwise.
